editorial:
Detective Shaw is counting down the hours to retirement when a nightmare lands on his desk: a serial killer has buried his son alive. From that first phone call, the movie moves fast, throwing Shaw into a race against the clock to solve three murders and find his son before time runs out. It has the tense, ticking-clock feel of a classic thriller, but the story keeps things personal by focusing on a father who has spent his career chasing bad guys and now has to save his own family. The action is big, the stakes feel real, and the movie never lets you get too comfortable.

What really stands out is how the film balances action with emotion, giving Shaw a strong, worn-down presence that makes every choice feel heavy. The twists keep coming, and the pacing rarely slows down, though some side characters could use more depth. If you like high-stakes thrillers with a clear goal and a ticking clock, this is an easy recommendation. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or add the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection if you want the best picture and sound.
endingExplained: In the final act, Shaw follows the clues from the three murders and discovers the killer is someone close to the case, not a stranger. The last clue leads him to a construction site, where he digs up his son just before the air runs out. The killer is caught, but not before one final fight. The movie ends with Shaw choosing to stay on the force a little longer, realizing retirement can wait while his family heals.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves ticking-clock thrillers and action movies with heart.
